business_rules.title: Business Rules
business_rules.desc: Centralized control of operational workflows. Procurement approvals, inventory behavior, accounting posting and clinical safety — all configurable per tenant.
business_rules.readonly_note: Read-only — only Owner or Corporate Admin can change business rules.
business_rules.require_po_approval_desc: Purchase Orders must be approved before they can be received.
business_rules.require_grn_approval_desc: Goods Receipt Notes must be approved before posting to stock.
business_rules.require_purchase_return_approval_desc: Purchase returns require approval before stock & ledger changes.
business_rules.require_transfer_approval_desc: Stock transfers between branches require approval.
business_rules.allow_negative_stock_desc: Allow POS, sales, transfers and returns to go below zero stock.
business_rules.allow_backdated_entries_desc: Allow transactions to be recorded with a past date.
business_rules.enable_fefo_desc: First-Expiry-First-Out batch allocation. When off, FIFO is used.
business_rules.enable_batch_tracking_desc: Show batch fields and validate batch numbers across workflows.
business_rules.enable_expiry_control_desc: Warn about and block expired batches in sales and dispense.
business_rules.enable_supplier_ledger_desc: Post supplier ledger entries idempotently on purchases and payments.
business_rules.enable_journal_posting_desc: Auto-post journal entries for POs, supplier payments and purchase returns.
business_rules.enable_clinical_safety_desc: Run interaction, allergy and dosage checks on prescriptions.
business_rules.require_safety_ack_desc: Pharmacist must acknowledge safety warnings before dispensing.

invoice.title: Invoice Settings

pos.title: POS Settings
pos.desc: Control POS workflow: defaults, barcode behavior, customer rules, pricing, payments, hold sale and hardware.
pos.readonly_note: Read-only — only Owner or Corporate Admin can change POS settings.
pos.barcode_auto_add_desc: Exact barcode match adds to cart automatically.
pos.customer_required_desc: Block checkout until a customer is selected.
pos.enable_split_payment_desc: Cash, card, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, bank in one sale.
pos.auto_print_receipt_desc: Print receipt automatically after a successful sale.
pos.cash_drawer_enabled_desc: Show cash drawer actions in POS.

inventory.title: Inventory Settings
inventory.desc: Centralize batch, expiry, transfer, adjustment and stock control rules.
inventory.readonly_note: Read-only — only Owner or Corporate Admin can change inventory settings.
inventory.default_expiry_warning_days_desc: Used by Expiry Radar, dashboard, notifications and reports.
inventory.enable_expiry_tracking_desc: When off, expiry UI and warnings are hidden.
inventory.require_expiry_on_purchase_desc: GRN is blocked if expiry date is missing.
inventory.default_low_stock_threshold_desc: Used when a product has no reorder level set.
inventory.enable_batch_tracking_desc: When off, batch fields and validation are hidden.
inventory.enable_negative_stock_desc: When off, POS, sales, transfers and adjustments are blocked below zero.

medicine.title: Medicine Settings
medicine.desc: Centralize medicine master, clinical safety, alternatives, SKU and duplicate rules.
medicine.readonly_note: Read-only — only Owner or Corporate Admin can change medicine settings.
medicine.require_generic_desc: Block product save without a generic name.
medicine.require_manufacturer_desc: Block product save without a manufacturer.
medicine.require_strength_desc: Block product save without strength (e.g. 500 mg).
medicine.require_medicine_type_desc: Block product save without dosage form / type.
medicine.require_pack_size_desc: Block product save without pack size.
medicine.default_medicine_status_desc: Status applied to newly created medicines.
medicine.enable_drug_interaction_desc: Warn on conflicting medicines during prescription review.
medicine.enable_allergy_check_desc: Warn on patient allergies during prescription review.
medicine.enable_dosage_validation_desc: Validate dose against medicine and patient profile.
medicine.enable_alternative_medicine_desc: Show substitute suggestions in POS and prescription review.
medicine.allow_duplicate_barcode_desc: Permit two products sharing the same barcode.
medicine.allow_duplicate_sku_desc: Permit two products sharing the same SKU.

reports.title: Reports Settings
reports.desc: Centralize date ranges, exports, visibility, modules, refresh and scheduling for all reporting.
reports.readonly_note: Read-only — only Owner or Corporate Admin can change reports settings.
reports.default_date_range_desc: Applied to dashboards and reports on first open.
reports.show_profit_reports_desc: Gross profit, net profit, profit KPIs and widgets.
reports.show_margin_reports_desc: Margin %, product, category and executive margin dashboards.
reports.show_cost_price_desc: Cost columns, purchase cost, inventory cost and COGS views.
reports.enable_executive_reports_desc: Executive dashboard, BI dashboard and forecast.
reports.enable_clinical_reports_desc: Clinical dashboard, refill, safety and prescription reports.
reports.enable_financial_reports_desc: Trial balance, ledger, balance sheet, P&L, AP reconciliation.
reports.enable_inventory_reports_desc: Aging, batch register, expiry and stock reports.
reports.enable_procurement_reports_desc: Purchase, supplier and purchase return reports.
reports.show_logo_in_exports_desc: Embed tenant logo in PDF and XLSX header.
reports.show_signature_in_exports_desc: Embed authorized signature in PDF exports and statements.
reports.enable_auto_refresh_desc: Dashboards refresh automatically on the chosen interval.
reports.refresh_interval_desc: Applies to executive, clinical, BI and KPI dashboards.
reports.enable_scheduled_reports_desc: Run scheduled reports and daily/weekly/monthly digests.

number_series.title: Number Series
number_series.desc: Centralized auto numbering for all documents. Prefix and starting number per document, race-condition safe.
number_series.readonly_note: Read-only — only Owner or Corporate Admin can change number series.
number_series.lock_note: Numbers are issued via a per-tenant advisory lock — safe for multi-user and multi-warehouse use.
number_series.invalid_prefix: Prefix must be 1–12 of A-Z, 0-9, _ or -.
number_series.invalid_start: Start must be a positive integer.
